questions.text: Will any part of an existing exterior wall be removed?
questions.help: For example, to open the house into the addition.

requirements.label: Addition project description
requirements.plainLanguage: A written description of the addition: its size, its use and anything existing that will be removed.

details.label: Description of the proposed addition
details.missingMessage: Add description of the proposed addition.
details.whereToAdd: Project description: describe the size and use of the addition.

details.label: Description of exterior-wall removal
details.missingMessage: The project description is incomplete. Update it to include the proposed removal of the existing exterior wall.
details.whereToAdd: Project description: state that the existing exterior wall will be removed.

requirements.label: Addition site plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A bird's-eye drawing of your lot showing where the addition goes.

details.label: Addition location
details.whereToAdd: Site plan: draw the addition and label it 'proposed addition'.

requirements.label: Existing floor plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A floor plan of the rooms as they are today, so reviewers can compare before and after.

details.label: Existing floor layout
details.whereToAdd: Existing floor plan: show the current layout of the affected rooms.

requirements.label: Proposed floor plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A floor plan of the new layout that clearly shows which parts are existing and which are new, with window sizes and framing (joist and stud sizes and spacing).

details.label: Proposed floor layout
details.whereToAdd: Proposed floor plan: show and label the new rooms.

details.label: Distinction between existing and proposed work
details.missingMessage: Existing and proposed work are not clearly differentiated. Use labels, line styles or another clear method to distinguish new construction.
details.whereToAdd: Proposed floor plan: add a legend and use different line styles for existing and new work.

details.label: Proposed window sizes
details.missingMessage: Window information is incomplete. Add the proposed window sizes.
details.whereToAdd: Proposed floor plan: write the size next to each new window.

details.label: Framing information
details.whereToAdd: Floor, roof or framing plan: label joists and rafters with size and spacing.

requirements.label: Foundation plan and sections
requirements.plainLanguage: A drawing of the addition's foundation (footings and foundation walls) with a wall section showing how the addition is built.

details.label: Addition foundation details
details.whereToAdd: Foundation plan: show footing and foundation wall sizes.

details.label: Sections and construction details
details.whereToAdd: Sections: add a wall section showing the construction layers.

requirements.label: Addition roof plan
requirements.plainLanguage: A drawing of the roof from above, including how the new roof connects to the existing one.

details.label: Roof layout
details.whereToAdd: Roof plan: show the roof outline and slope.

details.label: Existing and proposed roof connection
details.missingMessage: The roof connection is unclear. Add a detail showing how the proposed roof connects to the existing building.
details.whereToAdd: Roof plan or a detail: show how the new roof ties into the existing roof.

requirements.label: Addition elevations
requirements.plainLanguage: Drawings of each outside wall the addition changes.
requirements.missingMessage: An exterior elevation is missing. Add the elevation for the affected side of the building.

details.label: Elevations for every affected side
details.missingMessage: An exterior elevation is missing. Add the elevation for the affected side of the building.
details.whereToAdd: Elevations: include every side of the building the addition changes.
